name: Inuzuka Chihiro
source:
Occupation: Public Health Doctor
Hobbies: Bowling, darts
Foods that he isn’t good with: Spicy things
Favorite Words: The fires of love, in some cases leaves the ashes of friendship behind.

The public health doctor of the school that the heroine attends. His bright and friendly personality makes him popular, he always welcomes the female students but never takes up male students. He is clear with his likes and dislikes and though he has a sharp tongue, he is quite friendly. To please a woman, he goes to such an extent to study topic spots. His change in attitude and look is easy to understand in front of his favorite type of woman. He has a habit of licking his lips, Tsukasa is his kouhai at his university.
